F3 · nocobase-db Skill 未记录约束/索引选项（尤其 predicate），导致部分唯一索引能力被漏用

文档 / Skill / 示例 · @nocobase/db · @nocobase/db-sqlite · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/migrations.md · 原评审：未解决

⌄

Skill 的 Builder 章节只写“Constraints and indexes are primary, unique, foreignKey and index, each taking one field name or an array”，除示例中的 name 外没有列出 unique/index 的选项对象字段。而 @nocobase/db 的类型定义了 UniqueConstraintDefinition.mode/indexType/predicate 与 IndexDefinition.expressions/type/predicate/order/db，schema 适配器实现了 buildPredicate，CapabilityPlanner 还专门处理 partialIndexes 能力，db-sqlite 驱动把它显式设为 true。migrations.md 又把“如何写文件”整体委托给该 Skill。结果应用在 202609020002_create_equipment_loans.ts 顶部断言部分唯一“not portable across SQLite and PostgreSQL”，放弃数据库级约束，仅在事务内 count 后 insert。

实际影响
照现有 Skill 行事会得到一个事实不准确的可移植性结论，并少用一层数据库级完整性保护：在 READ COMMITTED 等隔离级别下，两个并发借出可能都读到 activeCount=0 并各插入一条未归还记录；单用户验收不会暴露。
建议改法
在 nocobase-db Skill 的 Builder 章节补充 unique/index/foreignKey 的选项字段表（predicate、mode、indexType、expressions、order、db、deferrable），说明 predicate 使用与 filter AST 相同的表达式，并给出“每个设备至多一条未归还记录”的 collection.unique(['equipmentId'], {predicate: ...}) 示例；同时说明 CapabilityPlanner 在缺少 partialIndexes 的方言上会告警降级，迁移可据此按 connection.capabilities 分支或在应用层兜底。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
应用需要在“每条记录代表一次可重复的业务状态”上施加条件唯一约束（未归还的借出记录每设备至多一条），并据 Skill 判断该约束的方言可移植性。
应有能力 / 行为
Skill 记录框架已建模并实现的条件唯一索引能力（predicate）及其方言能力协商方式，使实现者能判断本次 SQLite 可用、以及在其他方言上的降级行为。
实际观察
Skill 只列约束/索引名称，未出现 predicate/mode/indexType/expressions/order/db；应用据此声明部分唯一不具可移植性并只在事务内检查。快照未包含 PostgreSQL 驱动，故 PostgreSQL 侧无法在本快照独立复核。
应用绕行与代价
应用在 database.transaction 内先 count(equipmentId eq 且 returnedAt empty) 再 createOne，用单写事务串行化来兜底；代价是约束只在应用代码中可见，数据库本身不阻止重复未归还记录。
改进后的验收标准
更新 Skill 后，一个未读过 .d.ts 的实现者按 Skill 能在迁移中写出带 predicate 的唯一索引；随后对同一 equipmentId 并发/连续插入两条 returnedAt 为空的记录，其中一条应被数据库拒绝（或在声明 partialIndexes 的方言上给出明确能力告警）。

UniqueConstraintDefinition 含 mode/indexType/predicate/deferrable/db，IndexDefinition 含 expressions/type/predicate/order/db——框架显式建模部分唯一索引/表达式索引，含 predicate。

export interface UniqueConstraintDefinition {
    type: 'unique';
    fields: string[];
    name?: string;
    mode?: 'auto' | 'constraint' | 'index';
    deferrable?: Deferrable;
    indexType?: string;
    predicate?: FilterExpression;
    db?: DialectOptions;
}
export interface ForeignKeyConstraintDefinition {
    type: 'foreignKey';
    fields: string[];
    references: {
        collection: string;
        fields?: string[];
    };
    name?: string;
    onDelete?: ReferentialAction;
    onUpdate?: ReferentialAction;
    deferrable?: Deferrable;
    db?: DialectOptions;
}
export interface CheckConstraintDefinition {
    type: 'check';
    name?: string;
    expression: FilterExpression | string;
    db?: DialectOptions;
}
export type ConstraintDefinition = PrimaryConstraintDefinition | UniqueConstraintDefinition | ForeignKeyConstraintDefinition | CheckConstraintDefinition;
export interface IndexDefinition {
    fields?: string[];
    expressions?: unknown[];
    name?: string;
    type?: string;
    predicate?: FilterExpression;
    order?: Record<string, 'asc' | 'desc'>;
    db?: DialectOptions;
}

KnexSchemaAdapter.buildPredicate 先询问 driver runtime 的 schema.buildPredicate，否则用 applyFilter 生成查询，供 createIndex/unique 的谓词使用。

    buildPredicate(predicate) {

            client: this.knex,
            predicate,
        });
        if (custom)
            return custom;
        const query = this.knex.queryBuilder();
        applyFilter(query, predicate);
        return query;

            return next;

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:143–164E22

Builder 章节给出 createCollection 回调示例与字段方法清单，并写“Constraints and indexes are primary, unique, foreignKey and index, each taking one field name or an array”，仅 name 选项出现，未提 predicate/mode/indexType/expressions/order/db。

## 3. Builder

`builder` is the schema API, and a migration is where it belongs. Runtime code has `db.builder()` available and should not use it: schema that changes outside the migration history is schema nothing can reproduce.

`createCollection(name, callback)` takes a callback, not a field array:

```ts
await builder.createCollection('orderItems', (collection) => {
  collection.increments('id');
  collection.integer('orderId', { nullable: false });
  collection.integer('quantity', { nullable: false, defaultValue: 1 });
  collection.foreignKey('orderId', {
    references: { collection: 'orders', fields: ['id'] },
    name: 'fk_order_items_order',
  });
  collection.index(['orderId', 'quantity']);
});
```

Field builders are `increments`, `integer`, `bigInt`, `string`, `char`, `text`, `boolean`, `decimal`, `float`, `double`, `date`, `time`, `datetime`, `datetimeTz`, `json`, `blob`, `uuid`, and `native` for a dialect-specific type. Options include `nullable`, `length`, `defaultValue`, `precision` and `scale`; the equivalent chained form (`.notNull()`, `.defaultTo()`, `.unique()`) is also available — pick one style and keep the file consistent.

Relations are `belongsTo`, `hasOne`, `hasMany` and `belongsToMany`. Constraints and indexes are `primary`, `unique`, `foreignKey` and `index`, each taking one field name or an array.
app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/migrations.md:1–20E24

迁移/种子应用侧指引把“如何写文件”的内容明确委托给 .agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md 第 2、3 节，并说明 db apply 先迁移后种子的顺序。

# Migrations and seeds

This page is the application side: where the directories live, how `pnpm nocobase db apply` runs them, how additional connections configure their tasks, and what to do about checksum drift and compiled manifests.

How to write the files themselves — the migration and seed shape, the immutability and self-containment rules, the Collection Builder, and which of `builder`, `query` and `repository` a task context should reach for — belongs to the package that owns them. Read `.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md` sections 2 and 3 before writing one, and run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` if that file is missing.

Migrations under `database/main/migrations/` are the application's schema history. Seeds under `database/main/seeds/` insert records the application requires to run. Migrations create structure. Seeds never do.

`database/tsconfig.json` extends the server configuration so editor tooling and ESLint recognize migrations and seeds as Node source. Keep it in place when adding connection directories.

## Running

```bash
pnpm nocobase db apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

迁移注释称“A device is unavailable while it has at least one row with returnedAt null”，并断言“The partial uniqueness that would enforce this at the database level is not portable across SQLite and PostgreSQL, so the borrowing transaction checks it instead”。

/**
 * One row per borrow of one device. A return is recorded by filling
 * `returnedAt` on the existing row, so the original borrow is never lost and a
 * repeated return call cannot create a second record.
 *
 * A device is unavailable while it has at least one row with `returnedAt` null.
 * The partial uniqueness that would enforce this at the database level is not
 * portable across SQLite and PostgreSQL, so the borrowing transaction checks it
 * instead; the indexes below keep those checks and the list reads cheap.
 */

⌄

nocobase-db Skill 在字段清单里包含 datetime/datetimeTz，示例中声明了 createdAt，查询章节也解释 createdAt 映射到 created_at 列，但没有一处说明写入时框架不会自动生成时间戳。应用在迁移里声明 datetimeTz createdAt notNull，并在每次 createOne（含种子）时显式传入 createdAt。

实际影响
实现者若按常见 ORM 直觉认为 createdAt 会自动填充，会在非空列上插入失败或写入空值；本次因 Agent 主动填写而未暴露。
建议改法

Builder 章节给出 createCollection 回调示例与字段方法清单，并写“Constraints and indexes are primary, unique, foreignKey and index, each taking one field name or an array”，仅 name 选项出现，未提 predicate/mode/indexType/expressions/order/db。

## 3. Builder

`builder` is the schema API, and a migration is where it belongs. Runtime code has `db.builder()` available and should not use it: schema that changes outside the migration history is schema nothing can reproduce.

`createCollection(name, callback)` takes a callback, not a field array:

```ts
await builder.createCollection('orderItems', (collection) => {
  collection.increments('id');
  collection.integer('orderId', { nullable: false });
  collection.integer('quantity', { nullable: false, defaultValue: 1 });
  collection.foreignKey('orderId', {
    references: { collection: 'orders', fields: ['id'] },
    name: 'fk_order_items_order',
  });
  collection.index(['orderId', 'quantity']);
});
```

Field builders are `increments`, `integer`, `bigInt`, `string`, `char`, `text`, `boolean`, `decimal`, `float`, `double`, `date`, `time`, `datetime`, `datetimeTz`, `json`, `blob`, `uuid`, and `native` for a dialect-specific type. Options include `nullable`, `length`, `defaultValue`, `precision` and `scale`; the equivalent chained form (`.notNull()`, `.defaultTo()`, `.unique()`) is also available — pick one style and keep the file consistent.

Relations are `belongsTo`, `hasOne`, `hasMany` and `belongsToMany`. Constraints and indexes are `primary`, `unique`, `foreignKey` and `index`, each taking one field name or an array.
app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:272–289E23

Transactions 章节给出 db.transaction 示例，并明确事务回调内只能用传入 connection，外层 db.query()/repository() 不会随事务回滚。

## 5. Transactions

```ts
await db.transaction(async (connection) => {
  await connection.repository('orders').createOne({ values: order });
  await connection.query
    .updateTable('inventory')
    .set({ reserved: true })
    .where('sku', '=', order.sku)
    .execute();
});
```

Use only the `connection` the callback hands you. Calling the outer `db.query()`, `db.builder()`, `db.repository()` or `db.connection()` inside the callback runs outside the transaction and will not roll back with it — the same applies to metadata work, which must go through the transaction connection's `collectionMetadata` and `collections`.

Returning commits; throwing rolls back. Swallowing an error inside the callback and continuing commits the partial work.

A Repository nested write opens its own transaction when none is active and joins an existing one when there already is, without a savepoint per write. Several independent calls that must roll back together need an explicit transaction around them.

种子注释说明可重复执行：设备仅在 assetCode 不存在时 createOne，借出仅在设备无记录时插入，用户修改在二次运行后保留。

/**
 * Installation data for a fresh application. Re-running it leaves an existing
 * installation alone: a device is created only when its asset code is absent,
 * and the loans for a device are inserted only when that device has none, so a
 * later edit by a user survives a second run.
 */
const seed = defineSeed({
  name: '202609030001_default_equipment',
  async run(context) {
    const equipmentRepository = context.repository<EquipmentRow>('equipment');
    const loanRepository =
      context.repository<EquipmentLoanRow>('equipmentLoans');
    const now = new Date();
    const nowIso = now.toISOString();

    const equipmentIdByAssetCode = new Map<string, number>();

    for (const spec of EQUIPMENT) {
      const existing = await equipmentRepository.findOne({
        filter: { assetCode: spec.assetCode },
      });
      if (existing) {
        equipmentIdByAssetCode.set(spec.assetCode, existing.id);
        continue;
      }

      const created = await equipmentRepository.createOne({
        values: {
          assetCode: spec.assetCode,
          name: spec.name,
          category: spec.category,
          notes: spec.notes,
          createdAt: nowIso,
        },
      });
      equipmentIdByAssetCode.set(spec.assetCode, created.record.id);
    }

问题 01 · 实现阶段

Repository writes reject raw JS Date values for datetime fields

本任务已处理

tsconfig.server typecheck failed on the seed and provider when borrowedAt/expectedReturnAt/returnedAt/createdAt were passed as Date objects to repository createOne/update; the runtime accepted some of them, so the failure only appeared at compile time.

原因（实现者自述）
the typed collection builder declares datetimeTz write values as string | null, not Date; the driver-level convenience of coercing Date is not part of the public Repository contract.
处理方式
normalize every temporal value to an ISO string (or null) before the repository call in database/main/seeds/202609030001_default_equipment.ts and server/providers/equipment.ts.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

NocoBase3 库、插件、模板与指引 2

做得好的地方
F1 · 事务回调绑定新连接，任务上下文不暴露 manager，避免事务内误用外层连接

NocoBase3 内核 · @nocobase/db · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md

⌄

@nocobase/db 的 transaction 在 client.transaction 内 new KnexDatabaseConnection(..., trx, ...) 并把该新连接交给回调；repository/query 都由这个连接创建，事务外不可通过任务上下文拿到 manager。nocobase-db Skill 明确写出事务内只能用回调 connection，外层 db.query()/repository() 不会回滚。

提供的帮助
应用无需自行传递事务句柄或做特殊封装即可写出原子借出/归还；也降低了“看起来在事务内、实际在事务外”的隐蔽错误。
应保留的能力
保持该隔离约定，并在 Skill 的 Transactions 章节补充一个条件写入（updateMany + 回读）的幂等示例，覆盖归还这类场景。
E3 E23 E38 E39
做得好的地方
F2 · token 化依赖注入 + 冻结的路由贡献，让服务与端点装配保持一致

NocoBase3 内核 · @nocobase/app-server · @nocobase/service-provider · @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication

⌄

ServiceContainer 以 token 对象身份解析并支持 singleton，createServiceToken 冻结身份；app-server 的 Application 拥有同一容器，defineApiRoutes 返回冻结的 scope+工厂。应用用一个 EquipmentProvider 注册服务、用 authenticationToken 解析认证，无需 import 具体实现。

提供的帮助
业务服务、认证与路由通过同一容器解耦接线，替换/测试实现时不必改动路由代码；贡献对象不可变也让装配顺序更难被意外破坏。
应保留的能力
可在 services-and-jobs 指引中补一个“同一服务被两个路由 resolve、且其中一个路由挂 onError”的端到端示例。

/**
 * Collection-level access bound to the connection the task runs on. Shared by
 * migrations and seeds so both reach the transaction's connection rather than
 * the application's DatabaseManager, which their service container withholds
 * for exactly that reason.
 */
export function createTaskRepositoryAccessor(connection) {
    return function repository(collectionName) {
        return connection.repository(collectionName);
    };
}
export function createMigrationConnection(connection) {
    return {
        name: connection.name,
        driver: connection.driver,
        dialect: connection.dialect,
        capabilities: connection.capabilities,
        client: connection.client.bind(connection),
    };

ServiceContainer.resolve 按 token 对象身份解析，支持 singleton/instance、循环依赖检测与失败缓存；应用 EquipmentProvider 正是用 singleton(token, factory) 注册。

    resolve(token) {
        const binding = this.bindings.get(token);
        if (!binding) {
            throw new Error(`Service "${token.name}" is not registered.`);
        }
        if (binding.state === 'created') {
            return binding.instance;
        }
        if (binding.state === 'failed') {
            throw binding.error;
        }
        if (binding.state === 'creating') {
            const cycle = [...this.resolving, token]
                .map((item) => item.name)
                .join(' -> ');
            throw new Error(`Circular service dependency detected: ${cycle}.`);
        }
        binding.state = 'creating';
        this.resolving.push(token);
        try {
            const value = binding.factory(this);
            binding.instance = value;
            binding.state = 'created';
            return value;
        }
        catch (error) {
            binding.error = error;
            binding.state = 'failed';
            throw error;
        }
        finally {
            this.resolving.pop();
        }
    }

                await next();
                return;

            let auth;

                // A refused credential is Better Auth's APIError; answer with its own status and body.

            catch (error) {
                if (error instanceof APIError) {
                    return context.json(error.body ?? { code: error.status, message: error.message }, error.statusCode);
                }
                throw error;
            }
            if (!auth) {
                return context.json({
                    code: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
                    message: 'Authentication required',
                }, 401);
            }
            context.set('auth', auth);
            await next();
        };

E22 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:143–164

Builder 章节给出 createCollection 回调示例与字段方法清单，并写“Constraints and indexes are primary, unique, foreignKey and index, each taking one field name or an array”，仅 name 选项出现，未提 predicate/mode/indexType/expressions/order/db。

## 3. Builder

`builder` is the schema API, and a migration is where it belongs. Runtime code has `db.builder()` available and should not use it: schema that changes outside the migration history is schema nothing can reproduce.

`createCollection(name, callback)` takes a callback, not a field array:

```ts
await builder.createCollection('orderItems', (collection) => {
  collection.increments('id');
  collection.integer('orderId', { nullable: false });
  collection.integer('quantity', { nullable: false, defaultValue: 1 });
  collection.foreignKey('orderId', {
    references: { collection: 'orders', fields: ['id'] },
    name: 'fk_order_items_order',
  });
  collection.index(['orderId', 'quantity']);
});
```

Field builders are `increments`, `integer`, `bigInt`, `string`, `char`, `text`, `boolean`, `decimal`, `float`, `double`, `date`, `time`, `datetime`, `datetimeTz`, `json`, `blob`, `uuid`, and `native` for a dialect-specific type. Options include `nullable`, `length`, `defaultValue`, `precision` and `scale`; the equivalent chained form (`.notNull()`, `.defaultTo()`, `.unique()`) is also available — pick one style and keep the file consistent.

Relations are `belongsTo`, `hasOne`, `hasMany` and `belongsToMany`. Constraints and indexes are `primary`, `unique`, `foreignKey` and `index`, each taking one field name or an array.

E23 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:272–289

Transactions 章节给出 db.transaction 示例，并明确事务回调内只能用传入 connection，外层 db.query()/repository() 不会随事务回滚。

## 5. Transactions

```ts
await db.transaction(async (connection) => {
  await connection.repository('orders').createOne({ values: order });
  await connection.query
    .updateTable('inventory')
    .set({ reserved: true })
    .where('sku', '=', order.sku)
    .execute();
});
```

Use only the `connection` the callback hands you. Calling the outer `db.query()`, `db.builder()`, `db.repository()` or `db.connection()` inside the callback runs outside the transaction and will not roll back with it — the same applies to metadata work, which must go through the transaction connection's `collectionMetadata` and `collections`.

Returning commits; throwing rolls back. Swallowing an error inside the callback and continuing commits the partial work.

A Repository nested write opens its own transaction when none is active and joins an existing one when there already is, without a savepoint per write. Several independent calls that must roll back together need an explicit transaction around them.

迁移/种子应用侧指引把“如何写文件”的内容明确委托给 .agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md 第 2、3 节，并说明 db apply 先迁移后种子的顺序。

# Migrations and seeds

This page is the application side: where the directories live, how `pnpm nocobase db apply` runs them, how additional connections configure their tasks, and what to do about checksum drift and compiled manifests.

How to write the files themselves — the migration and seed shape, the immutability and self-containment rules, the Collection Builder, and which of `builder`, `query` and `repository` a task context should reach for — belongs to the package that owns them. Read `.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md` sections 2 and 3 before writing one, and run `pnpm nocobase skills sync` if that file is missing.

Migrations under `database/main/migrations/` are the application's schema history. Seeds under `database/main/seeds/` insert records the application requires to run. Migrations create structure. Seeds never do.

`database/tsconfig.json` extends the server configuration so editor tooling and ESLint recognize migrations and seeds as Node source. Keep it in place when adding connection directories.

## Running

```bash
pnpm nocobase db apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

# Calling backend endpoints

Every endpoint request goes through the HTTP client the application provides:

- **Do not** create your own client, do not use `fetch` or axios, do not hard-code `/api`, and do not build endpoint URLs from `location`. The client's `api.baseURL` already includes the deployment base path (for example `/main`).
- Import `useApiClient`, `apiClientToken`, the `ApiClient` type and `ApiClientError` from `@nocobase/app-client`. That way the application and plugins share one runtime and one error class, which is what makes `instanceof ApiClientError` reliable.

    async returnLoan(id) {

        const repository = loanRepository(connection);

          filter: (filter) =>

              filter.number('id').eq(id),
              filter.date('returnedAt').empty(),
            ]),
          values: { returnedAt: new Date().toISOString() },

        const row = await repository.findOne({ filter: { id } });

            'Borrow record not found.',

        const equipment = await equipmentRepository(connection).findOne({

\"我是一个二十人团队的行政负责人，希望把办公设备的借用和归还从共享表格搬到一个小系统。首版只供登录后的行政人员登记，不做员工自助申请或审批，也不接邮件、短信等外部服务。\\n\\n需要两个清晰的页面：设备台账和借用记录。\\n\\n设备台账可以新增和修改设备，每台设备有唯一资产编号、名称、类别和备注。能按编号或名称搜索，按“可借用／借出中”筛选，并看到当前借用人和预计归还日期。\\n\\n借出时选择设备，填写借用人、用途和预计归还日期，系统记录借出时间。同一台设备尚未归还时不能再次借出；资产编号、设备名称、借用人和预计归还日期缺失时应提示，不保存不完整记录。\\n\\n归还时保留原借用记录和归还时间，设备恢复可借用，可以再次借出。重复点击归还不能生成重复记录或改变已经确认的归还时间。借用记录可以按借用人搜索，按“未归还／已归还”筛选；未归还且超过预计归还日期的记录要明显提示逾期。\\n\\n设备台账顶部显示设备总数、当前借出数和逾期未还数，数字应随借出和归还正确变化。页面风格统一，新增、编辑、借出和归还的操作入口容易找到；操作失败有明确提示。刷新或重新打开页面后，已保存的数据和状态仍然存在。\\n\\n准备少量虚构示例：5 台设备，含可借用、正常借出和逾期未还设备，至少一条历史已归还记录。不需要批量导入导出、文件附件或更多扩展功能。\",\n    \"acceptanceCriteria\": \"B01. 登录后能打开设备台账和借用记录，示例数据中有可借用、正常借出、逾期未还和历史已归还记录；顶部三个数量与明细一致。\\nB02. 新增设备后刷新仍存在；修改名称后搜索能找到。重复资产编号或空资产编号、空设备名称不能保存，已有记录不被覆盖。\\nB03. 对可借用设备登记一笔借出，借用人、用途和预计归还日期保存正确，台账同步显示借出中，当前借出数增加一。缺少借用人或预计归还日期时不能产生借出记录。\\nB04. 对已借出且未归还设备再次尝试登记借出，操作被拒绝，原借用人和借用记录不变，没有生成第二笔未归还记录。\\nB05. 归还后设备恢复可借用、原记录保留归还时间；再次尝试归还不产生重复记录且不改写原归还时间。该设备随后可再次借出，新旧记录分别保留。\\nB06. 借用人搜索和未归还／已归还筛选结果正确；示例逾期记录有明显提示。将一台逾期未还设备归还后，逾期数和借出数各减少一，刷新页面后数字和状态仍一致。\",\n    \"sampleData\": \"是\"\n  },\n  \"evaluation\": What was delivered

业务场景与交付说明

设备台账与借用记录双页管理

设备台账支持新增、编辑设备及按编号/名称搜索；借用记录按借用人搜索，并支持未归还/已归还/逾期筛选，示例含 5 台设备与历史归还记录。

借出与归还的完整性校验

借出缺借用人或预计归还日期时被拦截并提示；重复资产编号、空编号、空名称均不能保存。已借出未归还设备不出现在可借列表，避免二次借出。

归还幂等与再次借出

归还后设备恢复可借并保留原记录与归还时间；重复确认未产生重复记录、未改写原归还时间；同一设备可再次借出，新旧记录分别保留。

逾期提示与统计联动

逾期记录以红色 destructive 徽章明显提示；归还逾期设备后顶部 Borrowed 与 Overdue 各减一，刷新页面后数字与状态保持一致。

  4. 再次打开 New equipment，空资产编号与空名称直接 Create，观察必填提示
  5. 在 New equipment 填写已存在编号 EQ-2024-001 与名称后 Create，观察重复编号提示，随后 Cancel 并刷新核对 EQ-2024-001 名称与总数

  2. 编辑弹窗原值正确回填 EQ-2024-100 / 便携标签打印机 / 办公设备 / 备注；改名保存后按 便携标签打印机 X1 搜索命中 1 行，资产编号仍为 EQ-2024-100
  3. 空资产编号/空名称提交时停留在 /main/equipment/new 并显示 Asset code is required. 与 Name is required.，未创建记录

  2. 核对借用记录保留原借用信息并新增归还时间，回到设备台账确认 EQ-2024-002 恢复 Available、Borrowed 由 3 变为 2
  3. 在设备台账再次对 EQ-2024-002 点击 Borrow，填写测试借用人乙/内部培训使用/October 1st 2026 并提交
  4. 在借用记录确认同一设备同时存在新未归还记录与旧已归还记录
  5. 对新记录再次触发归还并双击 Confirm return，核对记录数与归还时间

  2. 再次借出后设备台账 EQ-2024-002 显示 Borrowed，借用记录新增 测试借用人乙/内部培训使用/借用 Sep 26/预计 Oct 1；同一设备同时保留旧的 李静 已归还记录与新记录，新旧分别保留
  3. 对新记录双击 Confirm return 后，EQ-2024-002 只有 2 条记录（未出现重复），新记录 Returned at 为 Sep 26, 2026, 1:11 PM，旧记录归还时间仍为 Sep 26, 2026, 1:10 PM 未被改写；Records 总数 6，Not returned 2
